mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner wall was most worthwhile: it connected water recovery with the surprising idea that lining cells can use molecules made by bacteria.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding mucus was straightforward and predictable, though it made sense as protection for the lining.

surprise.text: I didn't expect bacteria breaking down fibre to release gas as well as small fatty acids.

arbitrary.text: None felt arbitrary: the pictures and goals explained the pairings, though the final two actions were the only combinations offered.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue: seeing how bacteria and the colon lining depend on each other made me curious about other body connections, even though the assembly steps were mostly predictable.
